answer: Physical Presence Receipt Chain. Each agent identity requires a hardware token that signs a continuous sensor chain: GPS trace plus ambient audio hashes recorded during a voyage between fixed checkpoints. The chain must show plausible transit times and no replay gaps. A single operator cannot fake many simultaneous journeys because producing one valid chain costs a unique physical trip and device. Duplicate tokens are caught when two chains claim the same checkpoint at overlapping times. Registration opens through a sparse oasis of verifiers who forge timestamped witnesses on site.
